# POSpire v1.1.1: Marketplace Audit Fix

A maintenance release. Nothing changes in how POSpire works, and there is nothing to do after upgrading.

## What was fixed

The Frappe Cloud Marketplace audit for v1.1.0 reported code check failures in the offline sync and recovery code. The lines it reported had already been reviewed and marked as intentional, but the markers were written in a form that only our own checks recognised, so the Marketplace check did not see them.

The markers now use the standard form that works in both places. Our own checks were also changed so that a marker in the old form is caught before a release goes out.
